summary: This lecture is already the public source spine for America as a playable national and world board: Nation owns the American-game mechanism, Legitimacy Fiction owns rules making players, and Dollar Hegemony owns the reserve-currency world-game machinery.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: America is not an ethnicity or a land but a game; the citizen is a player, and Bretton Woods / world-game institutions scale the board outward.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The public Nation page already uses this exact source as the durable American-game anchor. The episode read links several marks to this lens point, so the impact pass should close accounting rather than create a new America page.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: The World Bank lends entry money, the IMF turns repayment failure into policy discipline, and trade, bank-transfer, legal, and central-bank pipes make the board playable everywhere.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The episode read already links the debt-discipline and institutional-pipes marks to this Nation anchor.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: The dollar is an idea, America is a game, the general will supplies secular legitimacy, and citizenship turns people into players.
existing_lens_links.rationale: Legitimacy Fiction already carries the rule-system surface for this source, and the episode read links the central game/player marks to that anchor.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: The dollar becomes the reserve value standard; loans, debt discipline, trade rules, SWIFT, and central-bank coordination turn the American game into a dollar world game.
existing_lens_links.rationale: Dollar Hegemony already uses this lecture as its clean source spine. A later provenance pass may add read links only if it batches several exact dollar-world-game marks.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: No immediate append is needed. Preserve this lecture as the primary public anchor for America as a playable collective body and global board, then use the 2025 Empire Of Democracy source only in a future replacement/comparison pass that preserves chronology.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Nation owns the board and citizen-player mechanism. Civilization owns the anti-civilization reversal in the earlier 2025 source; Legitimacy owns rule fiction; Dollar Hegemony owns reserve-demand machinery.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Keep this source as the modern rule-system formulation: legitimacy becomes playable when abstract rules, rights, money, property, and citizenship make people experience political order as a field for agency rather than direct command.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Legitimacy receives rules that create players and rightful order. It should not absorb the national-board, dollar-hegemony, or anti-civilization layers.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Keep this lecture as the opening source spine for dollar hegemony: the dollar makes wealth conceptual, Bretton Woods defines reserve value, institutions make the board playable, post-1971 demand rests on petrodollars and China, and the current era is a game reset.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Dollar Hegemony owns reserve currency, institutional entry, dollar demand, petrodollar/China demand, and game-reset pressure. Power owns symbol-to-reality conversion more generally.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use only in comparison with the earlier 2025 source: America as game is the later world-board expression of an anti-civilizational cure that replaces inherited culture, sacrifice, and prejudice with Enlightenment rules and playable incentives.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Civilization owns the inner-order contrast and cure/reversal question, not the dollar operating system or the standalone America topic.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use the source's merit claim only when comparing American openness, fairness, clarity, and talent reward to later meritocracy pressure; do not recast the whole American-game source as a school or credential page.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Meritocracy receives the talent/status bridge only when the active mechanism is reward selection or credential pressure. Nation remains the primary owner of the American game.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold Civil War, frontier closure, expansion, and current Russia/China challenge as strategy pressure only when the democratic board becomes material expansion, resource hierarchy, or war-test logic.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Strategy owns the material test and conflict over the board. It should not reopen a broad Strategy split or become the America page.

new_lens_seeds.title: American Game Reset
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: A rule-maker's board becomes unstable when the internal capitalist concentration problem, post-gold dollar demand, China entry, financial speculation, resource challenges, and rival diversification make the game visible as a controlled system rather than neutral opportunity.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The phrase connects Jiang's domestic American-game model to later dollar-hegemony, China, Russia, BRICS, and resource-hierarchy pressure without collapsing those mechanisms into one prediction.
new_lens_seeds.reason: Hold as comparison pressure only. Dollar Hegemony and Nation already carry the current public surfaces; a new page would likely duplicate them unless future sources require a narrower reset hover surface.

chronology_notes.note: The 2026-01-27 lecture is the later world-board formulation already used by the public Nation and Legitimacy anchors. The 2025-05-15 Empire Of Democracy source is earlier and should be treated as the civilization-course formulation when public prose is revised.
This source gives the dated January 2026 world-game spine from conceptual dollar wealth to Bretton Woods, post-1971 demand creation, China dollar use, price hierarchy, and current reset pressure.

The student-question ending distinguishes American subordination from Chinese diversification: China tries to build markets and resource access outside U.S. dominance rather than simply copying America's board.
